Tarrant Property Data Profile

About this page

Everything Tarrant CAD makes available to us, from two sources: the bulk files downloaded from the CAD website, and the Agent Portal API. For each file or endpoint you get its columns or fields, data types, completeness and value distributions.

Team review: mark each column Need, Maybe or Drop and leave notes in the column table. A decision or note on a column applies to the same raw file in every download that has it. Everyone with access sees changes live.

Sources: www.tad.org/resources/data-downloads (checked 2026-11-23) · our copies in Google Drive · County Playbooks › Tarrant › Public Information. Pick a file below, or search for a table or column at the top.

Notes and decisions load when this page is opened on claude.ai.
